|game_text=USED: Retrieve a device, or ▲ a device. (Immune to [[Sense]].) STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, ▼ a farm, two devices, and two Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-155E-Harvest-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). The release-sheet slip, the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip show the original words (see [[Harvest (V)]], [[Harvest (V) (Errata 2)]] and [[Harvest (V) (Errata 3)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Harvest (V)]]): Virtual Block 1 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 155E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=10 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 10, slip 155E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref>: “USED: ▲ (or retrieve) a device. (Immune to Sense.) STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, ▼ a farm, two devices, and two Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-155E-Harvest.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 155E at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 1 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1210_154">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock1Type (Virtual Block 1 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “USED: Retrieve a device, or ▲ a device. (Immune to Sense.) STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, ▼ a farm, two devices, and two Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' One change: “▲ (or retrieve) a device.” is reworded as “Retrieve a device, or ▲ a device.”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Harvest (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-harvest-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual1-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual1-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034541/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “USED: ▲ (or retrieve) a device. (Immune to Sense.) STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, ▼ a farm, two devices, and two Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (155E).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Harvest (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 34)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1210-154-front-master.png]]: “USED: ▲ (or retrieve) a device. (Immune to Sense.) STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, ▼ a farm, two devices, and two Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number, only the E mark at the bottom right. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
